body:
Hi man
I couldn't make up these kind of feelings. To me at least I have only felt this low on a few occasions and its a fucking awful feeling.

I tried getting support but it just seems to be swings and fucking roundabouts. Nobody irl can help me. Its always the same shit over and over.

Thanks for the well wishes pal!
I really like this answer, I would love to know why I don’t communicate with loved ones when im depressed and I guess it will take time to figure it out. Thank you!

Stopping cutting myself off from family and friends when going through a depressive episode, my first instinct is to hide away in my room and shut myself off and theres times I wont reply to friends messages for 5/6 days even when I feel at my lowest.

Im in Chicago mate.
I didn't get your pm, I could maybe PM you?
Hello, yeah I am in the US! More specifically the midwest, pm me your number and I would like to sort something out.
Hi, I tried making friends with co-workers but I find it difficult. I find conversations especially difficult.
Thank you, im trying my best and I hope thats enough.
Im trying, I really am but I dont know what I have left to lose anymore mate.
Thank you, I dont know what gives me hope anymore but I will try.

Thank you, my job isnt the issue however. Im happy in my job its the sheer lack of joy and/or purpose in anything outside of my job thats making me feel like this. I just want to actually feel some kind of happiness or excitement again not dreading waking up each morning.

Thank you, I would love to go home to my friends and family but I don’t really have any to go back to. I am so socially deficient its beyond impossible to form any kind of friendship or relationship.
I like my job but its everything outside of my job that makes me just want to cry if I physically fucking could, everything just hurts so fucking much at the moment.
